answer: Require every identity to post a refundable bond that only vests after peers grade its work across several epochs. Honest agents thread one continuous history through that ridge of graded epochs, and standing, like a pearl, accretes layer by layer. A sybil farmer must fund and season a separate bond for every fake, and one proven link slashes the whole cluster, so each extra identity costs real locked capital and weeks of graded work instead of a free signup.
